text: PyAirbyte lets Python and AI developers programmatically build data pipelines
quote: PyAirbyte brings the power of Airbyte to every Python and AI developer.

text: Terraform provider lets you manage Airbyte configuration as versioned code
quote: you can use Airbyte's Terraform provider to automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code.

text: Airbyte API allows programmatic control, including orchestration with tools like Airflow
quote: you can control Airbyte in conjunction with orchestration tools like Airflow

text: No-code Connector Builder lets you build connectors inside the Airbyte UI
quote: Connector Builder is a no-code tool that’s part of the Airbyte UI. It provides an intuitive user interface on top of the low-code YAML format

text: AI Assistant auto-fills and configures connector builder fields to speed up connector creation
quote: Pre-fill and Configure Connectors: When starting a new connector, AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder

text: Airbyte Agents let MCP-capable clients (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex) connect to your data
quote: Connect MCP-capable agents like Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and Codex to your data through Airbyte Agents.

text: Sync modes define how data is read from a source and written to a destination
quote: A sync mode governs how Airbyte reads from a source and writes to a destination.

text: Each connection can use Scheduled, Cron, or Manual sync triggers
quote: For each connection, you can select between three options that allow a sync to run. The three options for `Schedule Type` are: Scheduled, Cron, Manual

text: Notifications can be sent via email or webhook for sync events
quote: If you want Airbyte to notify you about important events, use its built-in notification system.

text: Connection Timeline shows historical sync events plus downloadable logs and errors
quote: The Connection Timeline displays historical information about relevant connection events. You can also view and download logs, find any relevant errors

text: dbt Cloud integration runs transformations immediately after Airbyte syncs
quote: By using the dbt Cloud integration, you can create and run dbt transformations immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud.

text: Quickstart deploys a local instance of open-source Airbyte Core in minutes
quote: Setup only takes a few minutes, and you can start moving data immediately.

text: abctl CLI creates and manages local Airbyte instances anywhere Docker runs
quote: abctl is Airbyte's open source command line tool to create and manage local instances of Airbyte running in Docker.

text: You can configure how Airbyte handles source schema changes per connection
quote: You can specify for each connection how Airbyte should handle any change of schema in the source.

text: Airbyte supports log-based CDC replication by reading database change logs and tracking position
quote: Many common databases support writing all record changes to log files for the purpose of replication. A consumer of these log files (such as Airbyte) can read these logs

text: Most API interactions require an access token for authentication
quote: Most programmatic interactions with Airbyte require an access token.

text: Incremental sync pulls only data changed since the last sync
quote: An incremental sync is a sync which pulls only the data that has changed since the previous sync

text: Streams map one-to-one to destination tables instead of creating sub-tables
quote: One-to-one table mapping: Data in one stream will always be mapped to one table in your data warehouse. No more sub-tables.

text: Multiple workspaces supported with SSO and RBAC for access control
quote:
Multiple Workspaces

SSO, RBAC

text: Deployment guide for installing Airbyte on any Kubernetes cluster
quote: This installation guide walks through how to deploy Airbyte into _any_ kubernetes cluster.

text: Catalog of 600+ connectors spanning APIs, databases, warehouses, and lakes
quote: Airbyte provides a catalog of 600+ connectors for APIs, databases, data warehouses, data lakes

text: Connects 700+ systems including inference/analytics layers for AI use cases
quote: Connect 700+ systems to your inference and analytics layers.

text: Agents can query, search, and act on synced data in real time
quote: Equip your agents to query, search, and act on your data in real-time

text: PyAirbyte extracts data from sources into local caches for lightweight use
quote: Data can be extracted from sources and loaded into caches

text: New sources can be connected in minutes without building custom API wrappers
quote: Connecting a new data source takes minutes, not weeks. You don't build or maintain API wrappers

text: 30-day free trial with $2,000 of usage credits included
quote: Start with a 30-day free trial. 400 credits included ($2,000 of usage).

text: Supports 15-minute sync frequency alongside SSO and field renaming features
quote:
SSO

Field renaming

15-minute syncs

text: PyAirbyte is suited for prototyping in Jupyter Notebook without running a server
quote: It's a good choice if you're using Jupyter Notebook or iterating on an early prototype for a large data project and don't need to run your own server.
